multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Lucy Snowe stays at the home of her godmother Mrs. Bretton.
Lucy is hired as a caregiver by Miss Marchmont.
Polly's father arrives to take her away, and later he inherits the title 'de Bassompierre'.
Lucy encounters the figure of a nun, which may be the ghost of a nun punished for breaking her vow of chastity.
Graham showers Polly with attention, leading to her deep devotion to him.
Lucy travels to the city of Villette.
Polly's father inherits the title 'de Bassompierre'.
Lucy discovers the nun's habit was a disguise worn by Alfred de Hamal.
Dr. John frequently visits the school because of his love for Ginevra.
Polly's visit is cut short when her father arrives to take her away.
Lucy finds employment as a nanny at Mme. Beck's boarding school.
Lucy boards a ship for Labassecour.
Lucy is arranged to live independently as the headmistress of her own day school.
